description:
WHAT: Port format_receipt_timestamp and format_receipt_timestamp_at from the reference implementation.

ALGORITHM:
1. Create crate-jmap-chat-client/src/utils.rs
2. Port format_receipt_timestamp(dt: &UTCDate) -> String from ~/PROJECT/crate-jmapchat-client/src/utils.rs
3. Port format_receipt_timestamp_at(dt: &UTCDate, now: DateTime<Utc>) -> String
4. Key: UTCDate comes from jmap_types::UTCDate; parse via chrono::DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(dt.as_ref())
5. Output format: 'HH:MM' for today, 'Yesterday' for yesterday, 'Mon' through 'Sun' for past week, 'DD/MM/YY' for older
6. Declare in lib.rs: pub mod utils;

DEFENSIVE RULES:
- On parse error: return dt.as_ref().to_owned() (the raw string) rather than panicking
- No unwrap() without comment

TESTS (from reference utils.rs test suite — independent oracle: UTCDate input strings are RFC 3339):
- format_receipt_timestamp_at_today: input 2h ago → 'HH:MM'
- format_receipt_timestamp_at_yesterday: 25h ago → 'Yesterday'
- format_receipt_timestamp_at_this_week: 3 days ago → weekday name e.g. 'Mon'
- format_receipt_timestamp_at_old: 8 days ago → 'DD/MM/YY'
- format_receipt_timestamp_at_parse_error: invalid date string → returns the input as-is

ACCEPTANCE: cargo test -p jmap-chat-client passes; cargo clippy -p jmap-chat-client -- -D warnings passes
title: jmap-chat-client: utils.rs — format_receipt_timestamp
